title: REST, JSON, Validation & Structured Errors
objectives: Validate input once at the edge
Design an error enum that maps cleanly to status codes

examples.name: errors.rs

exercise.prompt: Map errors to status codes: NotFound (404), Validation (422), Conflict (409), Internal (500) — then print the mapping.
hints: Client errors are 4xx; server faults are 5xx.
422 means "understandable but invalid" — the validation code.

questions.explanation: Validate at the trust boundary; inner layers receive trusted, typed values.

questions.prompt: A typed AppError enum beats Result<T, String> because…
options: callers can map kinds to status codes and tests can match kinds
questions.explanation: Structured errors carry machine-usable meaning across the boundary.
